title: Visualize Dequeue in a Circular Queue

blocks.content: Visualize Dequeue in a Circular Queue
Click the "Visualize this code" button below to see the new dequeue() in action.

1def dequeue(self):
2    if self.is_empty():
3        print("We can't remove elements. The queue is empty.")
4        return None
5    
6    item_removed = self.queue[self.front]
7    self.queue[self.front] = None
8    self.front = (self.front + 1) % self.capacity
9    self.count -= 1
10    return item_removed
